infotexts.JobDescription.medicaldoctor_arcane: A physician specializing in purification and prevention.
infotexts.JobDescription.medicaldoctor_mystic: A physician studying blood, the beyond, and monster remains.
infotexts.entitydescription.Touhou_Doctor_Arcane_B: Hold in both hands and use or aim. Requires a base doctor, both primary talent stages completed, Medical 80 and Magic 60. Consumed on registration. Activates next round or on a new doctor body after death. Lose 40% of total experience on activation and reselect profession talents; talents outside the old profession tree, skills and equipment remain.
infotexts.entitydescription.Touhou_Doctor_Mystic_B: Hold in both hands and use or aim. Requires a base doctor, both primary talent stages completed, Medical 80 and Weapons 60. Consumed on registration. Activates next round or on a new doctor body after death. Lose 40% of total experience on activation and reselect profession talents; talents outside the old profession tree, skills and equipment remain.
infotexts.talentdescription.Touhou_WhiteDoctor_Tal: +10% medicine application effectiveness. Medicine treatment additionally reduces bleeding by 5, radiation sickness by 2 and poison by 2.
Using medicine to treat additionally restores 10 oxygen and grants the patient 15 seconds of debuff resistance and -20% naturally decaying debuff duration.

While above 50% health, all friendly crew including yourself gain 20% resistance to oxygen deprivation, opiate addiction and chemical addiction. Fades within 2 seconds after losing coverage; identical auras do not stack.
Take 10% less attack damage; +10% maximum health and +10% burn resistance.

Treating with magical medicine grants the patient 15 flat extra vitality for 30 seconds. Reapplication refreshes duration without stacking. Expiration removes this temporary vitality, not permanent wounds.
infotexts.talentdescription.Touhou_NetherDoctor_Ta: -5% maximum health and +15% danmaku attack damage.
Reduce your own bleeding each second. Danmaku hits inflict additional bleeding. +5% maximum health.

Looting a monster corpse has a 15% chance to generate one Izanagi Material in its inventory. Each current corpse entity gets one attempt, including failures. Uses the native loot marker, which is not guaranteed to survive entity recreation after loading. Humans, pets and living targets do not count. +5% all attack damage.
Below 40% health, gain 30% resistance to blood loss and oxygen deprivation.
Deal 15% additional attack damage to living targets above 30% health.
infotexts.talentdescription.Touhou_Doctor_MiracleG: The first target you treat each round gains 10% physical damage resistance and shares 50% of damage taken with you.
infotexts.talentdescription.Touhou_Special_Doctor_: Skill cap increased to 130. +15% effective skill levels. +1 crafted item quality. Each Medical point grants 0.1% maximum health and 0.05% ranged attack speed; each bonus is independently capped at 15%.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.Touhou_WhiteDoctor: -20% naturally decaying debuff duration for 15 seconds.
20% resistance to oxygen deprivation, opiate addiction and chemical addiction.
15 flat extra vitality for 30 seconds. Reapplication refreshes duration.
